capabilities: convert selected text from Latin to Cyrillic
convert selected text from Cyrillic to Latin
bind a hotkey for quick conversion
extras: The README and manifest carry an automated-review notice ('This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff'); documentation is given in English, Russian, and Uzbek.
motivation: The README frames it as fixing the pain of having typed text in the wrong script, fixable with a single keystroke.
problem: Uzbek is written in both Latin and Cyrillic scripts, and text typed in the wrong script normally has to be retyped or converted by hand.
summary: Script converter that switches selected text between Uzbek Latin and Cyrillic with forced or auto-detected direction commands.
